Competitive price to begin with. Good package with some flexibility. Four years genuinely interest-free loan. 20 cents/kWh feed-in tariff and other rates fixed for two years. Hard to beat that.
Every thing went well only problem so getting them to send me a paper invoice, I had to ring them for that it was 1 hour on hold, ( couldn't get a reply by email 3 emails

13 years ago I paid Origin $10,000 to supply and install a 3.5 Kw system (14 Panels) with a 20 year guarantee on the panels. About 3-4 years later they contacted me to arrange for a different electrician to re wire all the panels because the original work was "wired incorrectly" and had to be re-done. After this the solar output increased significantly but there was no compensation for the "Lost" output. Late in March this year I noticed on the power bill that the solar output had reduced then stopped from December. The Inverter had an error message. I rang Origin to speak to the Solar department to see what the error message meant. I was told that at 13 years it was out of warranty anyway and there was no longer anyone who could interpret the error code and that they no longer have a solar department.The last part I believe because it looks like they have never known what they are doing.

Bought this three years ago but still trying to get it fixed. does not gererate any electiicity. waste of my time and efforts. suggest everyone dont but it.buy cheap one and it would last you more that the telephone call I made.

After reviewing the options, the original interest free option and reasonable pricing was attractive. However, after signing up the wheels fell off completely.Now more than 3 months on, I still don’t have a solution for the panels on my roof, a quote that I can buy off, and the complete lack of customer service has left me frustrated.I have had two site visits, multiple changes to the technology, and the proposed system has shrunk from 10.x to 6.x Kw system.I have been bounced between multiple sales people and I have now reached the point where I’ve been frustrated out of their process.Their presales process is great, their post sales service is horrible. Very professional install - finished in 5 hours for an 11KW system. Very clean job. Only issue is how long it took between placing the order to install - but that was due to shortage of solar panels In Australia.Now awaiting the final inspection for it to be turned on - excited.Also this is on an interest free three year plan which is a major plus.
Punctual, well prepared clear concise instructions.Grid connection took a few weeks but was flexible.
Hard to explain. We are still waiting o be connected, hopefully we will be connected.
All good, all organised by Origin solar, best deal, no worries chasing energy providers and installer and suppliers.

The clincher for me was 0% interest on system that was priced well.I'm still waiting on the install but it's a good enough setup, Goodwe inverter, JA Panels and Tigo optimisers. Origin was the only one to do an on-site inspection and quote.Their 2 year feed-in tariff and guarantee is persuasive and competitive. Gem/RACQ was helpful and competitive on price. Origin gave the best  price straight up and they listened to what we wanted . We were able to negotiate a better price as our shed , electrical system and position allowed a easy installation and local tradesman .

All 3 companies were punctual and pleasant to deal with.One’s quote was way too high.One was worryingly low.Only one was a specialist solar company, which gave them the edge over electricians who dabble in solar.

Very easy to work with over the phone, and very clear information. As my second home solar installation in the last 4 years this was a much more pleasant and problem-free experience. Sales group ok, plenty of communication and follow-up. Cost of system offset by higher feed in tariff.Installer competent but it did take a while before work happened and it took two days.Grid installation was slightly chaotic and required me to sort separately.It would have been more convenient if I had one person to deal with not three.Overall the process was ok...4/5.
Every thing from start to installation has been fantastic. The installer was safety conscious and detailed.

Had contact at my home form  [horan and bird/origin,] sales rep, was very good and easy to talk to explained everything, no pressure, quoted system I was interested in and the cost was ok.The installation was very good and excellent job, even in bad weather the got the job done. Install of panels: moved planned roof install and reduced by 3 panels.Quality of install: not square on the roof, having waterfall issues over the gutter line.Quality of product: inverter shuts down in the rainOrigin new connection: took over 10 months to sign up as a new customer and get feed in tarrifsOverall, pretty disappointed of paying top dollar for a reputable company to do a below average job.
Quoting was thorough. Accurate. Installation went well. Quick and efficient. Customer service. So far so good.

I chose Origin energy after a recommendation from a neighbour who have been elated with their energy savings after installing a solar system with Origin. I originally explored the idea of switching providers from Energy Australia who had been my retailer for more than a decade, and who I believed had been price gouging me for more than a year, and selected Origin on a large saving comparitive to actual energy consumption at two different addresses. The quoting process was clear and transparent and the installation itself seamless and professional.

I went with Origin due to convenience - they weren't the cheapest or most expensive but it was easy and they had interest free.The installation and equipment are fine, no problems there and I was very happy with the guys doing the install. All went well until there was a problem with my direct debit. I phoned up to get it fixed and somehow they messed up my solar payments, I ended up in credit on my electricity and debit on solar. I use Red Energy in my business and opposite when it comes to customer service - very helpful.I'm writing this because a friend mentioned Origin had good solar reviews.Before considering Origin  Google 'Origin energy reviews'  and proceed at your own risk.
Quick one day installation. Full support from Origin service team in organising the installation. A bit longer wait for the transfer from one provider to another, and meter upgrade.

I have do far been happy with the service , cost  and speed of replies , the install  will be I  two weeks . A total of 5 weeks from purchuse, I was expecting much longer turn around and am pleasantly surprised

Origin Solar. Why we choose? Hoping to get back up service if ever needed. Would we recommend? No. Why? Sales info was not very informative, just enough to sell you a system. The installers were great. As a recent buyer, my recommendation is do your research, and understand what you really need for your home (for the long term).

The entire process from getting and quote to the final installation was quick, informative, clear and I was able to negotiate an additional discount and very good FIT. Sales and quoting process was smooth and not pushy.Installation was done well, very neat and tidy, no rubbish left behind.Grid connection has taken a little while but in the time frame that we were told.

It's now nearly 12 months later and the readout is still not working correctly.  The daily power generated reading stops when the reading reaches 3.277 Kwhs.
